args.message:
Bump fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)

CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested
arrays. Affected ranges: <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed versions are
2.9.4 and 3.1.0. Staying on the 2.x line to avoid a major-version bump.

args.head: fix/cve-2026-31337-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Bump fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 (CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Fixes CVE-2026-31337 (severity: high) — unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.

Advisory details:
- Package: `fastjson`
- Affected: `<2.9.4`, `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`
- Fixed in: `2.9.4`, `3.1.0`

This PR pins `fastjson==2.9.4`, staying on the 2.x line rather than taking the
3.1.0 major-version bump, so no API changes are expected.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` -> `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**

## Notes for reviewer
Merging to `main` requires code-owner approval per policy.

**Changes**

- Bumped `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (commit `c8b8ab7878`). I chose the 2.x patch over 3.1.0 to avoid a major-version bump, since the advisory lists 2.9.4 as a fix.
